Hey Ben, booked the hotel for the knitting and stitching show in Harrogate. Three days of yarn stalls. Don't judge me.
The first World Science Fiction Convention, held in New York in 1939, drew about 200 fans. This programme booklet is one of the few that survive.
Photograph of a 1950s housewares convention in Chicago, where manufacturers showed new appliances to retailers across a vast exhibition hall.
We're live from the floor of the auto show, and folks, there's a huge crowd around that electric pickup!
Callers, are you heading to the comic con this weekend? Tell us your cosplay and we'll give away two weekend passes.

Turnout in yesterday's municipal vote reached 68 percent, the highest since 1994, according to official figures released this morning.

Tip: check your registration a month before polling day, and look up your polling place online so you're not searching that morning.
Voting by mail? Sign the envelope exactly as on your registration, and post it at least a week before the deadline.
Incumbent mayor defeated by 312 votes. A recount confirmed the challenger's narrow victory in Tuesday's city poll.
Record turnout in India's general election. More than 640 million people cast ballots over six weeks of voting.
My grandmother voted in South Africa's 1994 election. She queued for nine hours and said it was the best day of her life.

This wooden ballot box was used in Finland's 1907 parliamentary election, the first in Europe in which women could both vote and stand; 19 women were elected.
Campaign buttons from the 1960 US presidential race between John F. Kennedy and Richard Nixon, decided by about 112,000 popular votes.
Results are coming in from the eastern districts, and folks, the challenger is up eight points! This race is tighter than anyone predicted!
Election night on the radio: the polls have closed, the count has begun, and our panel is ready to call the first seats.

topic:FilmFestival.text: Just saw the new Iranian film at TIFF and the room gave it a standing ovation, I'm shaking 😭

The Rotterdam International Film Festival announces its Tiger Competition lineup: 14 first and second features from 18 countries.
The Sundance Film Festival will move to Boulder, Colorado, from 2027, ending its long run in Park City, Utah.
Q: Why premiere your documentary at a small festival? A: The audience there really watches. At the big ones, buyers walk out after twenty minutes.

Festival tip: buy a pass, see films by directors you've never heard of, and stay for the Q&A; that's where the magic happens.
Submitting a short to festivals? Read each one's premiere rules carefully; many top programmes accept world premieres only.
Palme d'Or goes to first-time director. The jury praised the Senegalese drama's quiet power at the closing ceremony in Cannes.
Venice opens with star-studded premiere on the Lido. Photographers crowded the red carpet as the 83rd edition got under way.
At the Berlinale it was minus ten and I queued at 7 am for tickets. Watched five films in one day and dreamed in subtitles.
We run a tiny film festival in our village hall. Last year a director from Lagos came, and we fed her shepherd's pie.

The first Cannes Film Festival was planned for September 1939 but cancelled when war broke out; it finally opened in 1946.

Movie talk, callers: who should take the jury prize this year? Our critic loved the Chilean western.

topic:MilitaryConflict.text: Watching a doc on the Battle of Stalingrad, can't believe how cold it was 😳
History essay due Fri on why Britain, France and Russia fought in Crimea in the 1850s, help!!
The museum announces a new exhibition on the Thirty Years' War, opening in March, featuring letters from soldiers and civilians caught up in the conflict.
The ministry announces a commemoration on 14 June for veterans of the 1982 Falklands War, marking the anniversary of the Argentine surrender.
Q: Why did the Hundred Years' War last so long? A: It wasn't continuous fighting. Long truces separated campaigns, and the disputed claim to the French throne kept reviving it.

Revision tip: for any conflict on your exam, make a timeline with three columns: causes, key battles, and the peace settlement.
Visiting Gettysburg? Start with the cyclorama at the visitor centre, then drive the auto tour to see how the three days of fighting unfolded.
Divers locate Armada wreck off Irish coast. The ship, lost in 1588 as the Spanish fleet fled north around Scotland, lies in 20 metres of water.
Study revises toll of the Thirty Years' War. Researchers estimate the 1618-1648 conflict killed up to a third of the population in parts of Germany.
My grandfather fought in Korea. He never talked about it, except to say he'd never been as cold in his life as at the Chosin Reservoir.

The Battle of Agincourt, 1415: English longbowmen helped Henry V defeat a much larger French army on a muddy field.

On History Hour tonight: why did the fighting in Vietnam divide a generation? Our guest served two tours there and later became a historian.
Caller asks how the Wars of the Roses got their name. Our guest says the label came much later, popularised by Shakespeare and Victorian writers.

topic:MusicFestival.text: Glasto line-up just dropped!!! 😱 need to get tickets this time

Camping for three days of live music? Pitch your tent near a landmark flag, not by the toilets, and set it up before the first band.
